# VegSeal

> A trust-first vegan and vegetarian food scanner. Scan a barcode or ingredient label, understand the result, and find similar alternatives that match your preference.

VegSeal answers one question exceptionally well: can I eat this if I'm vegan or vegetarian? It never guesses — when an ingredient's origin is uncertain, it clearly says so. If you need another option, Find Alternatives checks candidate products' ingredients before showing verified matches. A selected store is shopping context only, not proof of local availability.

## Pages
- [Home](/): Scan a product, search, and see recent scans.
- [Scan](/scan): Barcode scanner, ingredient photo scanner, and paste mode.
- [Search](/search): Search products by name or brand.
- [Product result](/result/): Understand a product's status and open Find Vegan/Vegetarian Alternatives from eligible results.
- [About](/about): What VegSeal is and how it works.
- [Privacy](/privacy): Privacy practices.
- [Terms](/terms): Terms of use.
